method: Every final page opened separately with view_image from the actual 150 dpi render; no contact sheet. Observations entered by the reviewing agent after viewing. Layout review only, not byte-perfect clipboard acceptance.

pages.observation: Navigation and scope notice readable; no clipped rows.
Cover A: separated layers and dashed guides clear; title/art separated.
Cover B: tallest strokes now below subtitle; fine construction lines visible.
Cover C: contour lines distinct at render scale; no title collision.
Cover D: large type contained; artwork and attribution separate.
Hierarchy specimen and grid table fit; no heading confused with paragraph.
Back/spine placeholders explicitly marked; actual Atlas excerpt legible.
Chapter opening, complete code and both output lines fit; no gutter.
Mixed prose/code/table; excerpt gap labeled and full table grid visible.
Vector diagram now has allocated height; no collision with prose/code. Two nodes, rightward dotted copy arrow and both attached notes match source.
Kept informer bitmap: all labels and cache-reading dashed edge visible; caption follows image.
Prediction prompt and full code; no answer disclosed on question page. Whitespace intentional.
Answer H4 rendered as heading, both paragraphs intact; long inline diagnostic wraps.
Zero-value table: headers and five rows separated by full grid, readable cells.
Dense Library Atlas prose remains 14 pt; heading not orphaned.
Informer image/caption then source anchor/code, all readable; paragraph continues normally.
Three-line paragraph continuation plus complete final paragraph. Short tail retained rather than shrinking text.
Dense two-column Atlas; A01–A09 kept as entries, A06 diagnostics now separate bullet lines.
A10–A14 then labeled excerpt gap/J06–J07; warnings and actions separated, no split entry.
J08–J11: long diagnostics wrap inside columns, angle brackets and warning/action cues visible.
Seven original references remain in order with full URLs; no clipped text.
Both code experiments have readable Unicode, empty line and indentation; appearance passes, exact copy does not.
Approval gate and unresolved requirements explicit; no invented publication-ready claim.
